name: NTU-Fi HAR and Human-ID
summary: Paired Atheros-platform benchmarks for six-class human activity recognition and gait-based identification of fourteen people.

settings.scenario: HAR in three layouts; gait identity with a T-shirt, coat, or backpack

original.license: Dataset license not stated; official-source fetch only

standardization.notes: Follow SenseFi's official 2000-to-500 packet selection, preserve all 114 subcarriers and three antenna streams as 1 Tx × 3 Rx, and add the official normalized amplitude as a companion array. The 100 Hz task view is an assumed grid because physical packet cadence is absent from the processed files.
